## STON1 Locus Visualization

This script generates a plot for the region **chr2:48,528,591-48,531,995**, highlighting the **STON1** gene and displaying ATAC-seq data from multiple conditions.

### Configuration

```{r config}
# ==============================================================================
# 0. Load Libraries
# ==============================================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(viridis)
    library(Gviz)
    library(rtracklayer)
    library(GenomicFeatures)
    library(org.Hs.eg.db)
    library(grid)

    # Safety check for BSgenome package
    has_bsgenome <- requireNamespace("BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38", quietly = TRUE)
    if (has_bsgenome) {
        library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
        Hsapiens <- BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38
    } else {
        message("Notice: 'BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38' not found. Sequence track will be skipped.")
        Hsapiens <- NULL
    }
})

# ==============================================================================
# 1. Configuration
# ==============================================================================

# Paths
mane_gff_path <- "../data/STON1_locus/MANE.GRCh38.v1.5.refseq_genomic.gff.gz"

bw_dir <- "../data/STON1_locus/bigwig"
if (!dir.exists(bw_dir)) {
    bw_dir <- "/Users/annaschoonen/Documents/AS_CGL_lab_sequencing_data_backup/broadpeaks_ATAC_nextflow_v3_12_1_22_nfcore_outputs_w_bigwig/bwa/mergedReplicate/bigwig"
}

output_dir <- "./outputs_STON1_locus/"

# Ensure output directory exists
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Target Gene to Highlight (Red)
HIGHLIGHT_GENES <- c("STON1")

# Region of Interest (Specific coordinates provided)
chrom <- "chr2"
start_pos <- 48528591
end_pos <- 48531995
region_gr <- GRanges(chrom, IRanges(start_pos, end_pos))

# Genome Build
gen <- "hg38"

# ==============================================================================
# 2. Data Preparation
# ==============================================================================

# 2.1 Load Gene Annotation (TxDb)
if (!file.exists(mane_gff_path)) stop("MANE GFF file not found!")
message("Loading TxDb...")
txdb_mane <- makeTxDbFromGFF(mane_gff_path, format = "gff")
seqlevelsStyle(txdb_mane) <- "UCSC"

# 2.2 Identify BigWig Files
# List all bigWigs in the directory
all_bws <- list.files(bw_dir, pattern = "\\.bigWig$", full.names = TRUE)
# Construct a named vector for easy access
names(all_bws) <- basename(all_bws)
# Strip GEO sample prefix if present
names(all_bws) <- sub("^GSM[0-9]+_", "", names(all_bws))

# Define plotting order/colors if desired
# Sorting manually or logically can help plot readability
# Example order based on filename logic (Time -> Dose)
# 48hr: 0, 10, 50, 100
# 96hr: 0, 10, 50, 100
ordered_names <- c(
    "96hr_0.mRp.clN.bigWig", "96hr_100.mRp.clN.bigWig"
)

# Filter essentially ensures we only use existing files
plot_bws <- all_bws[ordered_names]
plot_bws <- plot_bws[!is.na(plot_bws)] # Remove missing if any
```

### Helper Functions (Gene Model Construction)

These helpers construct the gene model tracks (UTR vs CDS logic) similar to the reference script.

```{r helpers}
# ==============================================================================
# 3. Create Tracks
# ==============================================================================

# 3.1 Gene Track (Expanded View, Standard Gviz)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# We use the TxDb directly.
# Gviz automatically handles CDS/UTR if the TxDb has that info (makeTxDbFromGFF does).
message("Creating Gene Track...")

gene_track <- GeneRegionTrack(txdb_mane,
    genome = gen, chromosome = chrom, start = start_pos, end = end_pos,
    name = "Genes",
    transcriptAnnotation = "group",
    showId = TRUE, # Force display of labels
    geneSymbols = TRUE, # Use the symbol column
    just.group = "left", # Anchor labels to the left edge of features in-window
    stacking = "full", # Full view (avoid collapsing)
    collapseTranscripts = FALSE, # Show all transcripts
    # Visuals
    fill = "black", col = "black", # Black color as requested
    fontcolor.group = "black", fontsize.group = 12,
    background.title = "transparent", col.title = "black",
    thinBoxFeature = c("UTR", "ncRNA", "utr", "3'UTR", "5'UTR"), # Ensure UTRs are thin
    col.line = "black",
    rotation.title = 0 # Rotate label to be horizontal
)

# 3.2 Map Symbols (Entrez -> Symbol)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Gviz TxDb tracks use Entrez IDs/Gene IDs by default in the "gene" column.
# We need to map them to Symbols for "transcriptAnnotation='symbol'" to work nicely.
if (length(ranges(gene_track)) > 0) {
    # Extract existing gene IDs (Entrez from GFF)
    # The 'gene' column in Gviz ranges usually holds the Gene ID
    gids <- gene(gene_track)

    # Remove "GeneID:" prefix if present (NCBI GFFs often have this)
    clean_gids <- gsub("^GeneID:", "", gids)

    # Identify unique IDs to map
    to_map <- unique(clean_gids[!is.na(clean_gids)])

    if (length(to_map) > 0) {
        # Map to Symbol using org.Hs.eg.db
        sym_map <- tryCatch(
            {
                suppressMessages(mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,
                    keys = to_map,
                    column = "SYMBOL",
                    keytype = "ENTREZID",
                    multiVals = "first"
                ))
            },
            error = function(e) {
                return(NULL)
            }
        )

        # Create a mapping vector
        if (!is.null(sym_map)) {
            # Map the clean_gids vector
            # Matches
            mapped_syms <- sym_map[clean_gids]

            # Fill NAs with original ID
            mapped_syms[is.na(mapped_syms)] <- clean_gids[is.na(mapped_syms)]

            # Update the track's group column (more reliable for labeling)
            ranges(gene_track)$group <- mapped_syms
            # Also update symbol for good measure
            ranges(gene_track)$symbol <- mapped_syms
        } else {
            # If sym_map is NULL, at least use the original IDs
            ranges(gene_track)$group <- clean_gids
            ranges(gene_track)$symbol <- clean_gids
        }
    } else {
        # No IDs to map, use whatever is there
        ranges(gene_track)$group <- clean_gids
        ranges(gene_track)$symbol <- clean_gids
    }
} else {
    warning("No transcripts found in this region.")
}


# 3.3 Data Tracks (ATAC-seq)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
data_tracks <- list()

# 1. Calculate Global Y-Max for minimal/consistent scaling
# Iterate through all files first to find the maximum score in the region
message("Calculating Global Y-Max...")
max_scores <- numeric(length(plot_bws))
i <- 1
for (bw_path in plot_bws) {
    imported_dat <- import.bw(bw_path, selection = region_gr)
    if (length(imported_dat) > 0) {
        max_scores[i] <- max(score(imported_dat))
    } else {
        max_scores[i] <- 0
    }
    i <- i + 1
}

# Add a 5% buffer to the global max
global_ymax <- max(max_scores) * 1.05
# Ensure a reasonable minimum if all are 0
if (global_ymax == 0) global_ymax <- 10

message(paste("Global Y-Max set to:", round(global_ymax, 2)))

# 2. Create Tracks
for (bw_name in names(plot_bws)) {
    bw_path <- plot_bws[[bw_name]]

    # Clean Name for Display (remove .mRp.clN.bigWig)
    disp_name <- sub(".mRp.clN.bigWig", "", bw_name)
    disp_name <- gsub("_", " ", disp_name) # e.g. "96hr 0"

    dt <- DataTrack(
        range = bw_path, genome = gen, type = "histogram",
        chromosome = chrom, name = disp_name,
        ylim = c(0, global_ymax), # Use Global Max
        col.histogram = "#8C8C8C", fill.histogram = "#8C8C8C", # Changed from blue to #8C8C8C
        background.title = "transparent",
        col.title = "black", fontcolor.title = "black", cex.title = 0.6,
        col.axis = "black", fontcolor.axis = "black", cex.axis = 0.5,
        margin = 2, innerMargin = 2,
        showTitle = TRUE
    )

    data_tracks[[bw_name]] <- dt
}


# 3.4 Genome Axis

# 3.7 Consensus Patient Tracks (Primary & Recurrent)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: Construct Matrix
construct_matrix <- function(files, region) {
    if (length(files) == 0) {
        return(NULL)
    }
    mat_list <- lapply(files, function(f) {
        gr <- import(f, format = "BED")
        seqlevelsStyle(gr) <- "UCSC" # Ensure consistent styling

        # Calculate coverage for the chromosome
        cov_rle <- coverage(gr)[[as.character(seqnames(region))]]

        # Extract the ROI window
        # Coverage Rle might be shorter than chromosome end, so window safely
        # Ensure we don't go out of bounds
        max_len <- length(cov_rle)
        reg_start <- start(region)
        reg_end <- min(end(region), max_len)

        if (reg_start > max_len) {
            # Region is entirely outside chromosome coverage?
            return(rep(0, width(region)))
        }

        sig <- as.numeric(window(cov_rle, start = reg_start, end = reg_end))

        # Pad if window was truncated
        if (length(sig) < width(region)) {
            sig <- c(sig, rep(0, width(region) - length(sig)))
        }

        # Binary Peak logic (1 if peak present, 0 otherwise)
        return(ifelse(sig > 0, 1, 0))
    })
    return(do.call(rbind, mat_list))
}

}
all_bed_files <- list.files(patient_bed_dir, pattern = "_properly_formatted\\.bed$", full.names = TRUE)

primary_files <- grep("Primary", all_bed_files, value = TRUE)
recurrent_files <- grep("Recurrent", all_bed_files, value = TRUE)

dt_r_con <- NULL

primary_consensus <- NULL
if (length(primary_files) > 0) {
    message("Building Primary Consensus...")
    primary_mat <- construct_matrix(primary_files, region_gr)
    if (!is.null(primary_mat)) {
        primary_consensus <- colSums(primary_mat)
    }
}

recurrent_consensus <- NULL
if (length(recurrent_files) > 0) {
    message("Building Recurrent Consensus...")
    recurrent_mat <- construct_matrix(recurrent_files, region_gr)
    if (!is.null(recurrent_mat)) {
        recurrent_consensus <- colSums(recurrent_mat)
    }
}

# Determine global max for consistent scaling across both tracks
max_p <- if (!is.null(primary_consensus)) max(primary_consensus) else 0
max_r <- if (!is.null(recurrent_consensus)) max(recurrent_consensus) else 0
global_max_consensus <- max(max_p, max_r)
if (global_max_consensus == 0) global_max_consensus <- 1

# Generate heatmap gradient: 0 is white, 1 to max are viridis colors
# Generate a discrete-looking heatmap gradient
# This ensures 0 is obviously white and integers 1-Max map exactly to viridis colors
v_colors <- viridis::viridis(global_max_consensus)
heatmap_gradient <- c("#FFFFFF", "#FFFFFF", rep(v_colors, each = 2))[1:(2 * global_max_consensus + 1)]

if (!is.null(primary_consensus)) {
    dt_p_con <- DataTrack(
        data = primary_consensus,
        start = start_pos:end_pos, width = 1,
        name = "Primary Consensus",
        type = c("heatmap", "histogram"), # Histogram adds the Y-axis (values)
        genome = gen, chromosome = chrom,
        ylim = c(0, global_max_consensus), # Consistent max scale
        yTicksAt = c(0, global_max_consensus), # Labels for min and max only
        gradient = heatmap_gradient, separator = 0,

        # Histogram settings (invisible, just for axis)
        col.histogram = "transparent", fill.histogram = "transparent",

        # Axis settings
        showAxis = TRUE, cex.axis = 0.45, col.axis = "black", fontcolor.axis = "black",
        background.title = "transparent",
        col.title = "black", fontcolor.title = "black", cex.title = 0.6,
        rotation.title = 0
    )
}

if (!is.null(recurrent_consensus)) {
    dt_r_con <- DataTrack(
        data = recurrent_consensus,
        start = start_pos:end_pos, width = 1,
        name = "Recurrent Consensus",
        type = c("heatmap", "histogram"),
        genome = gen, chromosome = chrom,
        ylim = c(0, global_max_consensus), # Consistent max scale
        yTicksAt = c(0, global_max_consensus), # Labels for min and max only
        gradient = heatmap_gradient, separator = 0,

plotTracks(final_list,
    from = start_pos, to = end_pos, chromosome = chrom,
    main = "STON1 Locus (chr2:48528591-48531995)", cex.main = 1, margin = 40, col.main = "black",
    sizes = sizes_vec, title.width = 2.2
)
dev.off()
message(paste("Saved PNG:", fname_png))
```

```{r zoom_visualization}
# 6.1 Define Zoom Region and Sizing
zoom_start <- 48530144
zoom_end <- 48530175
zoom_main <- "STON1 Locus - Zoom (chr2:48530144-48530175)"
h_seq <- 0.25 # Height for sequence track

message("Generating Zoomed Plots with Sequence Track...")

# 6.2 Assemble Zoom Track List (Heatmap Version)
# Order: Axis -> Sequence -> BigWigs -> Genes -> Hits -> CpG -> Peaks -> DNase -> FP -> M059J -> Heatmaps
final_list_zoom <- list(strack)
if (!is.null(seq_track)) final_list_zoom <- c(final_list_zoom, list(seq_track))
final_list_zoom <- c(final_list_zoom, data_tracks)
final_list_zoom <- c(final_list_zoom, list(gene_track))
if (!is.null(cpg_track)) final_list_zoom <- c(final_list_zoom, list(cpg_track))
if (!is.null(atac_peaks_track)) final_list_zoom <- c(final_list_zoom, list(atac_peaks_track))
if (!is.null(dnase_track)) final_list_zoom <- c(final_list_zoom, list(dnase_track))
if (!is.null(fp_track)) final_list_zoom <- c(final_list_zoom, list(fp_track))
if (!is.null(fp2_track)) final_list_zoom <- c(final_list_zoom, list(fp2_track))
if (!is.null(m059j_track)) final_list_zoom <- c(final_list_zoom, list(m059j_track))
if (!is.null(krab_hits_track)) final_list_zoom <- c(final_list_zoom, list(krab_hits_track))
if (!is.null(be4_hits_track)) final_list_zoom <- c(final_list_zoom, list(be4_hits_track))

# Calculate Zoom Sizes (Heatmap)
sizes_vec_zoom <- c(h_scale)
if (!is.null(seq_track)) sizes_vec_zoom <- c(sizes_vec_zoom, h_seq)
sizes_vec_zoom <- c(sizes_vec_zoom, rep(h_data, length(data_tracks)), h_gene)
if (!is.null(cpg_track)) sizes_vec_zoom <- c(sizes_vec_zoom, h_annot_small)
if (!is.null(atac_peaks_track)) sizes_vec_zoom <- c(sizes_vec_zoom, h_annot_small)
if (!is.null(dnase_track)) sizes_vec_zoom <- c(sizes_vec_zoom, h_annot_small)
if (!is.null(fp_track)) sizes_vec_zoom <- c(sizes_vec_zoom, h_annot_small)
if (!is.null(fp2_track)) sizes_vec_zoom <- c(sizes_vec_zoom, h_annot_small)
if (!is.null(m059j_track)) sizes_vec_zoom <- c(sizes_vec_zoom, h_annot_small)
if (!is.null(krab_hits_track)) sizes_vec_zoom <- c(sizes_vec_zoom, h_annot)
if (!is.null(be4_hits_track)) sizes_vec_zoom <- c(sizes_vec_zoom, h_annot_small)

total_height_zoom <- sum(sizes_vec_zoom)

# 6.3 Save Zoom Heatmap
fname_zoom_heatmap_pdf <- paste0(output_dir, "STON1_Locus_Zoom_Heatmap.pdf")
pdf(fname_zoom_heatmap_pdf, width = 7, height = total_height_zoom)
plotTracks(final_list_zoom,
    from = zoom_start, to = zoom_end, chromosome = chrom,
    main = zoom_main, cex.main = 1, margin = 40, col.main = "black",
    sizes = sizes_vec_zoom, title.width = 2.2
)
dev.off()

fname_zoom_heatmap_png <- paste0(output_dir, "STON1_Locus_Zoom_Heatmap.png")
png(fname_zoom_heatmap_png, width = 8, height = total_height_zoom, units = "in", res = 300)
plotTracks(final_list_zoom,
    from = zoom_start, to = zoom_end, chromosome = chrom,
    main = zoom_main, cex.main = 1, margin = 40, col.main = "black",
    sizes = sizes_vec_zoom, title.width = 2.2
)
dev.off()
```
